statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = true if and only if the following two conditions hold: (1) for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(rectangles), the open rectangles I_i = (x_i,a_i) x (y_i,b_i) and I_j = (x_j,a_j) x (y_j,b_j) are disjoint; (2) the union of all closed rectangles R_i = [x_i,a_i] x [y_i,b_i], for 0 <= i < len(rectangles), is exactly the closed bounding rectangle B = [Xmin,Xmax] x [Ymin,Ymax], where Xmin = min_i x_i, Xmax = max_i a_i, Ymin = min_i y_i, Ymax = max_i b_i. Equivalently, r = true exactly when the rectangles form an exact cover of a rectangular region, and r = false otherwise.
preconditions: len(rectangles) >= 1 and len(rectangles) <= 20000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(rectangles), len(rectangles[i]) = 4, and writing x_i = rectangles[i][0], y_i = rectangles[i][1], a_i = rectangles[i][2], b_i = rectangles[i][3], we have -100000 <= x_i < a_i <= 100000 and -100000 <= y_i < b_i <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns true, let c(p) be the number of indices i and corners C in {(x_i,y_i),(x_i,b_i),(a_i,y_i),(a_i,b_i)} with C = p. Let Xmin = min_i x_i, Xmax = max_i a_i, Ymin = min_i y_i, Ymax = max_i b_i. Then c(Xmin,Ymin) = c(Xmin,Ymax) = c(Xmax,Ymin) = c(Xmax,Ymax) = 1, and for every integer point p not equal to one of these four bounding-box corners, c(p) is even.
